Experimental Hexplate

3000 goldFinished item

A fighter item with attack damage, attack speed and health that lowers your ultimate cooldown and gives attack speed and move speed after you use it.

Stats

  • 40 Attack Damage
  • 20% Attack Speed
  • 450 Health

What it does

Hexcharged: Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste.

Overdrive: After casting your Ultimate, gain % Attack Speed and % Move Speed for 8 seconds.

When to buy it

Buy it on attack-damage fighters and junglers who use their ultimate to start fights.

Good on

Vi Xin Zhao Bel'Veth Vayne

Builds from

Tunneler Dagger Phage

In our champion builds

Vayne BotSituational: more speed and ult uptime (ranged value nerfed in 26.20)

When our guides switch to it

Squishy enemy team: Vayne
